primary_metric: mean measured activity of top-5 candidates within each held-out fold
condition_rationale: 60 C directly addresses warm operation; pH 7.5 and cryPow are preselected neutral-ish pH and crystalline substrate. No model results used for condition choice.
notes: ESM-2 is frozen. Grouped inner validation follows the outer grouping policy. Random and grouped outer folds may have different sizes; report size and normalize selection against same-fold random and oracle. Split variation is not a confidence interval.
